findings.problem: With no hint, 'Excuse me! / Sorry!' could also be answered with Entschuldige!, Entschuldigen Sie!, Verzeihung!, Tut mir leid! or the everyday loanword Sorry!, so more than one answer is right.
findings.fix: hint: the one-word noun, to get attention or apologise (not Tut mir leid or Entschuldige)

back.target: Excuse me! / Sorry! (a one-word noun used to apologise or to get someone's attention)
back.example: Excuse me, where is the toilet?

note: Exgüsi is Swiss German dialect, while Swiss Standard German also says Entschuldigung, so the regional text could say it is the spoken form.
